name: Ootori Kureha
source:
A cheerful and positive only child with a father whom passed away early, Kureha has been living with and been raised by her mother her entire life so far. Due to Hiiragi Genpaku's wishes, Kureha transferred to Mihotoke High, and was designated the job of being the Red Hotokenser. Doujima Mitsuki nicknames her "Hiyoko" and "Piiyo".

NOTE: Her default birthday is the 27th of February, but can be changed by the player.

[Based on the [URL=http://www.twofive.co.jp/hotokenser/chara/kureha.html]official website[/URL].]
